name: Matrimony.com Ltd
title: Matrimony.com Ltd - 540704 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Matchmaking billing up 10.5% YoY in Q4 with paid profiles down 4.3% YoY; ARPU-led growth, while Marriage Services losses widened to INR 5.7 crore and FY26 PAT fell to INR 34.2 crore.

triggers.label: Matchmaking ATV up 15.3% YoY
triggers.quote: Average transaction value for the Matchmaking business increased by 15.3% year-on-year and 3.6% over previous quarter.

triggers.label: Paid profiles down 4.3% YoY
triggers.quote: Paid profiles were 2.34 lakhs at the end of Q4, a decline of 4.3% year -on-year and growth of 3.3% over previous quarter.

triggers.label: Q1 PAT to more than double
triggers.quote: we expect the PAT to more than double in Q1 compared to Q1 of previous year.

guidance.quote: we expect the PAT to more than double in Q1 compared to Q1 of previous year.
we expect double digit billing growth also possibly this year as well. So, the high single digit growth or double -digit growth for the FY’27 as well.
The marketing expenses at this point of time is expected to be at the similar level until otherwise if there is any strong need to increase or decrease.

red_flags.label: Marriage Services EBITDA loss widening
red_flags.quote: EBITDA loss for the quarter was INR 5.7 crores compared to INR 3.2 crores in Quarter 3 and INR 4.9 crores in Q4 of last year.

red_flags.label: Paid profiles declining YoY
red_flags.quote: Paid profiles were 2.34 lakhs at the end of Q4, a decline of 4.3% year -on-year and growth of 3.3% over previous quarter.

red_flags.label: FY26 PAT down, revenue flat
red_flags.quote: PAT is at INR 34.2 crores as compared to INR 45.3 crores last year.

red_flags.label: Promoter pledge question deflected
red_flags.quote: In terms of share pledge, it's a personal thing.

we don't share the breakup of individual businesses
But in terms of when it will breakeven, definitely it's a long way to go.
